cases.title: SU(2) trace identity
cases.legitimate_use: Products of traces reduce to traces of concatenated or reversed loops.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Finite loop length and expectation factorization remain unproved.
cases.rejection_test: Test normalized traces at U=V=I and noncommuting matrices.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Interaction picture
cases.assumptions: Self-adjoint on-link generators; bounded local plaquette interactions
cases.legitimate_use: Eliminates unbounded on-link operators from propagation-norm estimates.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Does not remove electric dynamics or create a gap.
cases.rejection_test: Check support and norms; reject a transformed term on the wrong links.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Moment and variance variables
cases.unresolved_bridge: Finite feasibility does not identify the measure or ground state.
cases.rejection_test: Exact recurrence, support localizer, rational exclusion and kappa-zero controls.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Zero tilt
cases.assumptions: Haar branch of the finite one-plaquette measure
cases.unresolved_bridge: The first force identity alone is blind to the variance.
cases.rejection_test: Do not divide by kappa; test next recurrence.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Tree without charges
cases.assumptions: Finite connected tree; Gauss law at every vertex; no charges
cases.legitimate_use: Only the constant gauge-invariant state survives.
cases.unresolved_bridge: No nontrivial excitation or four-dimensional theory is obtained.
cases.rejection_test: Explicit tree gauge reduction and charged-boundary mutant.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Short cycles or changed boundary charges
cases.assumptions: Actual incidence and boundary Gauss constraints
cases.legitimate_use: Free physical energy threshold must be recalculated.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Square-graph gap constant cannot be imported.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Strong-coupling infinite lattice
cases.legitimate_use: Uniform stochastic/Euclidean estimates at fixed lattice spacing.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Weak-coupling continuum path leaves that sufficient regime.
cases.rejection_test: Translate beta_W=N^2 beta_SZ; keep generator types separate.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Exact two-dimensional theory
cases.legitimate_use: Controlled Wilson loops and reconstruction benchmark.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Dimensional extrapolation does not prove D=4.
cases.rejection_test: Retain dimension, topology and local-observable content.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Three-dimensional stochastic theory
cases.classification: changed dimension and possibly field content
cases.assumptions: Each source-specific gauge group, state space and local existence assumptions
cases.unresolved_bridge: Not physical-time pure nonabelian four-dimensional construction.
cases.rejection_test: Separate Higgs and Abelian branches and possible finite-time blow-up.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Center-stabilized compactification
cases.assumptions: Center symmetry; declared double-trace deformation; controlled small-circle/large-N regime
cases.unresolved_bridge: Removing deformation and decompactifying need uniform estimates and no unjustified interchange of limits.
cases.rejection_test: Track center symmetry, approximation remainder and finite-N spectrum along the path.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Exact auxiliary field
cases.assumptions: An exact convergent integral identity reproduces measure and observables
cases.legitimate_use: Alternative representation of the same theory.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Approximate elimination or changed Jacobian changes the theory.
cases.rejection_test: Integrate auxiliary field out and recover the original finite measure exactly.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: New physical mass or Higgs field
cases.legitimate_use: Defines a different theory with a possible different mass mechanism.
cases.unresolved_bridge: Does not solve the original pure-gauge problem without a removal/equivalence theorem.
cases.rejection_test: Show actual action, stress/energy and decoupling limit.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Flow time
cases.assumptions: Specified gauge-covariant flow and renormalized observables
cases.legitimate_use: Defines smoothed gauge observables and a scale.
cases.unresolved_bridge: It is not real time or a generated spectral mass.
cases.rejection_test: Keep flow-time, physical-time and lattice-spacing limits separate.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Running coupling and physical units
cases.assumptions: A derived or fitted renormalization prescription is declared
cases.legitimate_use: Rewrites the regulator path in common variables.
cases.unresolved_bridge: A freely chosen g(a) is only a diagnostic path.
cases.rejection_test: Retain alpha=g_H^2/(2a), lambda=2/(g_H^2 a), and all exposed a dependence.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Zero interaction and vanishing electric scale
cases.classification: parameter edge with possible singular spectral limit
cases.legitimate_use: Lambda-zero local influence vanishes; alpha positivity assumptions can fail in a limit.
cases.unresolved_bridge: An alpha-independent locality bound is not an alpha-independent gap bound.
cases.rejection_test: Compare independent links and explicit small-energy excitations.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied

cases.title: Weak plaquette perturbation of electric product vacuum
cases.assumptions: Infinite-dimensional gapped on-site blocks; static finite-range bounded plaquette interactions; matched empty boundary or proved padding; eta<c1 and c2 eta<1/2
cases.legitimate_use: An actual volume-uniform full and Gauss-restricted Hamiltonian gap at fixed spacing for sufficiently small kappa_H.
cases.unresolved_bridge: No evaluated numerical threshold; weak-bare-coupling continuum path kappa_H=4/g_H^4 exits the sufficient regime.
cases.rejection_test: Reject finite-dimensional-only source substitutions, unproved boundary transfer, missing smallness, numerical kappa-star claims and ground-state sector mismatch.
cases.status: reviewed route classification; no new simulation implied
